description: This Java class defines a Breadcrumb entity used in a web shop to manage navigation breadcrumbs, including language, item type, URL reference, and breadcrumb items.

classes.name: Breadcrumb
classes.description: A serializable class representing navigation breadcrumbs for a web shop, containing breadcrumb items, language, item type, and URL reference.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Returns the language associated with this breadcrumb.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Sets the language for this breadcrumb.

methods.name: getBreadCrumbs
methods.description: Returns the list of breadcrumb items.

methods.name: setBreadCrumbs
methods.description: Sets the list of breadcrumb items.

methods.name: setItemType
methods.description: Sets the item type of the breadcrumb.

methods.name: getItemType
methods.description: Retrieves the item type of the breadcrumb.
